PLAN "Postpartum On-Ramp Block (Weeks 10-14)"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "postpartum reconditioning without impact"

PHASES
  PHASE "On-Ramp (4 Weeks)" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 35m "Core + Upper Acclimation":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
          diaphragmatic_breathing 3x6 rpe 3 rest 45 seconds
          pelvic_tilt 3x8 rpe 3 rest 45 seconds
          bird_dog 3x6 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
          dead_bug 3x6 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
          dumbbell_press 3x8 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_row 3x8 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
          pallof_press 3x8 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hip_flexor_stretch 1m
          chest_stretch 1m
          back_stretch 1m
      DAY Wednesday training 35m "Lower Acclimation + Core":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
          cat_cow 2x8 rpe 3 rest 45 seconds
          glute_bridge 3x10 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
          goblet_squat 3x8 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
          reverse_lunge 3x6 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
          romanian_deadlift 3x8 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
          plank 3x20 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 1m
          quad_stretch 1m
          calf_stretch 1m
      DAY Friday training 35m "Full Body + Posture":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
          scapular_retraction 3x8 rpe 3 rest 45 seconds
          shoulder_press 3x8 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
          split_squat 3x6 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
          hip_thrust 3x8 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
          face_pull 3x10 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          pallof_press 3x8 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          lat_stretch 1m
          shoulder_stretch 1m
          spinal_twist 1m
    WEEK 2:
      DAY Monday training 40m "Core Progression + Upper":
        warmup:
          walking 6m
        main straight_sets:
          diaphragmatic_breathing 2x6 rpe 3 rest 45 seconds
          dead_bug 3x8 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          bird_dog 3x8 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          dumbbell_press 4x8 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          barbell_row 3x8 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          lateral_raise 3x10 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          pallof_press 3x10 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 1m
          back_stretch 1m
          neck_stretch 1m
      DAY Wednesday training 40m "Lower Strength + Core":
        warmup:
          walking 6m
        main straight_sets:
          cat_cow 2x8 rpe 3 rest 45 seconds
          goblet_squat 4x8 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          reverse_lunge 3x8 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          romanian_deadlift 4x8 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          calf_raise 3x12 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          plank 3x25 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 1m
          quad_stretch 1m
          calf_stretch 1m
      DAY Friday training 40m "Full Body + Posture":
        warmup:
          walking 6m
        main straight_sets:
          scapular_retraction 3x10 rpe 4 rest 45 seconds
          shoulder_press 4x8 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          glute_bridge 3x12 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          step_up 3x8 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          face_pull 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          pallof_press 3x10 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hip_flexor_stretch 1m
          lat_stretch 1m
          spinal_twist 1m
    WEEK 3:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Upper Push/Pull + Core":
        warmup:
          walking 7m
        main straight_sets:
          dead_bug 3x10 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          pallof_press 3x12 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          incline_press 4x8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          seated_row 4x8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          lateral_raise 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          tricep_pushdown 3x10 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          bicep_curl 3x10 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 1m
          shoulder_stretch 1m
          back_stretch 1m
      DAY Wednesday training 45m "Lower Strength + Glutes":
        warmup:
          walking 7m
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 4x8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          split_squat 3x8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          romanian_deadlift 4x8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          hip_thrust 3x10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          calf_raise 3x15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          plank 3x30 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 1m
          quad_stretch 1m
          pigeon_pose 1m
      DAY Friday training 45m "Full Body + Posture and Breath":
        warmup:
          walking 7m
        main straight_sets:
          diaphragmatic_breathing 2x6 rpe 3 rest 45 seconds
          scapular_retraction 3x12 rpe 5 rest 45 seconds
          shoulder_press 4x8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          step_up 3x10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          glute_bridge 3x15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          face_pull 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          pallof_press 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hip_flexor_stretch 1m
          lat_stretch 1m
          spinal_twist 1m
    WEEK 4:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Upper Volume + Core Control":
        warmup:
          walking 8m
        main straight_sets:
          dead_bug 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          pallof_press 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          bench_press 4x8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          cable_row 4x8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          lateral_raise 3x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          tricep_extension 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          hammer_curl 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 1m
          shoulder_stretch 1m
          back_stretch 1m
      DAY Wednesday training 45m "Lower Strength Focus":
        warmup:
          walking 8m
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 4x8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          split_squat 3x10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          romanian_deadlift 4x8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          hip_thrust 4x8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          calf_raise 3x15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          plank 3x35 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 1m
          quad_stretch 1m
          pigeon_pose 1m
      DAY Friday training 45m "Full Body Integration (No Impact)":
        warmup:
          walking 8m
        main straight_sets:
          diaphragmatic_breathing 2x6 rpe 3 rest 45 seconds
          scapular_retraction 3x12 rpe 5 rest 45 seconds
          shoulder_press 4x8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          step_up 4x10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          glute_bridge 3x15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          face_pull 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          pallof_press 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hip_flexor_stretch 1m
          lat_stretch 1m
          spinal_twist 1m
